verdict.rationale: Rive documents building interactive experiences that respond to user input, using timelines, keyframes, interpolation and state machines in the Editor. That implies no-code interactivity and transitions, but nothing shows screen-to-screen prototype wiring, and Rive explicitly positions itself as 'No mockups, no prototypes' rather than a prototyping tool. Missing for 10: documented screen/artboard linking for clickable flows, explicit trigger/hotspot configuration, overlay support, and hands-on corroboration of a designer prototyping workflow.
